title: The Torn Garment
reflectionText: Ahijah tore one garment into twelve pieces and placed ten in Jeroboam’s hands. The promised rule came with a spoken condition: listen, walk rightly, and keep Yahweh’s commands. What is it to receive a visible sign of responsibility while also hearing the terms that must govern it?
editorialNotes: Packet 017 initial writer output. Short-only owner plan. The retelling preserves Jeroboam’s appointment, Ahijah’s twelve-piece sign and ten-tribe word, the delayed division, the explicit condition in verse 38, Solomon’s attempt to kill Jeroboam, and the flight to Egypt without continuing into the revolt.
